column1: # ih_clauses.tsv — induction-hypothesis clause table for gen_ih_clause.py
# One line per clause; each emits Vsa/Sim/rows/IHClause_<name>.lean
# (namespace Vsa.Sim.IHClause.<name>). Columns (tab-separated):
# Columns are matched by the header row's names; `kind` may be omitted (= extra).
#   name    : clause name (Lean identifier, CamelCase); module and namespace suffix
#   kind    : extra  — pred : EvalExtra (N A SL φf φc sret.toNat c), embedded into the
#                      motive through `EvalIHWith.toM` (generated `extraM`, `ofWith`)
#             extraM — pred : EvalExtraM (N A SL φf φc sp sret m0 c), e.g. a footprint
#                      `footExtra F` (Vsa/Sim/ExitFootprint.lean); the motive is
#                      `EvalIHWithM extraM` (= `EvalIHF F` for footprints)
#             motive — pred : SpecSt → Nat → Addr → Expr → SpecSt → Value → Prop, the
#                      `EvalE` motive ITSELF (generated `clauseMotive`); use it when the
#                      retained fact depends on the returned VALUE, which an EvalExtraM
#                      cannot see — e.g. `EvalIHFP noArenaFoot` (footprint ∧ payload
#                      coverage of the returned value, Vsa/Sim/StrCmpCellClauses.lean)
#   pred    : the Lean term of the kind's type: the fact retained at the child's
#             actual return
#   imports : comma-separated modules the pred/dischargers need ('-' for none);
#             Vsa.Sim.TermCaseBundle, Vsa.Sim.ExitFootprint and Vsa.Sim.IHClauseSupport
#             are always imported
#   motives : clause motives of the OTHER eight relations, `Rel=<Lean term over the
#             relation's binders>` separated by ';' ('-' = all `True`); relations:
#             EvalArgs Call ExecS ExecInit ForLoop ForCond ExecStep ExecSeq
#   guard   : '-' or a Lean Prop over the `mEvalE` binders (`st d env e st' v`), e.g.
#             `Vsa.Sim.IHClauseGeneric.noAllocExpr e = true`; the EvalE motive becomes
#             `<guard> → EvalIHWithM extraM …`, so every clause child IH and the clause
#             parent of a step carry it (a step outside the guard is vacuous)
#   steps   : per-case discharge tags `<case>=<tag>` separated by ';', `*` = default
#             for every case not named; a case is a TermCases premise (hInt, hBinary, …)
#             whose PARENT relation has a non-True clause motive. Tags:
#               manual                — the field stays a residual (default)
#               generic:<id>          — the field stays; its doc comment names the
#                                       generic discharger <id> (agent L2) and the hook
#               from_old:<Lean term>  — wired: <term> maps the case's old-motive
#                                       conclusion (hOld) to the clause conclusion
#                                       (`EvalIHWithM extraM …`; use `ofWith` to lift
#                                       an `EvalIHWith extra` result)
#               exact:<Lean term>     — wired: <term> has exactly the field's type
#               unguarded:<term>|<proj_1>|…|<proj_k>
#                                     — wired (guarded clauses): <term> has the field's type
#                                       WITHOUT the guard on the EvalE child IHs and the
#                                       parent; proj_i : <guard parent> → <guard child_i>
#                                       for the i-th EvalE child (none for a leaf), e.g.
#                                       `unguarded:footprint.hNeg|noAllocExpr_unary`
#               unguarded:<Lean term> — wired (guarded clauses, cases without child
#                                       derivations): <term> has the field's type without
#                                       the guard; the generator discards the guard
#   notes   : free text

column1: Footprint
column8: the exit footprint outside the arena (L1 `noArenaFoot`: stack window ∪ result slot): children `EvalIHF noArenaFoot` → parent `EvalIHF noArenaFoot`. UNINHABITED as a whole (`hAssign`/`hFn`/`hCall` and string concatenation write the arena; `PROOF_CLOSURE_PLAN.md` task 0); the four closed leaves and the six one-child arms are wired from `IHClauseGeneric.footprint.<case>` (`Vsa/Sim/IHClauseGenericSupply.lean`), the remaining five EvalE steps are `footprint` generic hooks

column1: FootprintNA
column8: the `Footprint` clause guarded by the syntactic non-allocation predicate `noAllocExpr` (`Vsa/Sim/IHClauseGeneric.lean`): `hAssign`/`hFn`/`hCall` are vacuous under the guard, the four leaves are the unguarded closed leaf steps, and `hNeg`/`hNot`/the four logical steps take their row contract from the closed suppliers of `Vsa/Sim/IHClauseGenericSupply.lean`. Open: `hVar` (needs `footprint.hVar_of` at `Rows.VarLeafResid` + `VarPinnedSim`) and `hBinary` (`footprintNA.hBinary_of_base` still needs `DivOverflowCellF`, both `EqCellF`s and the four `BinStrCmpCellF`s) — `PROOF_CLOSURE_PLAN.md` task 0 step (b)

column1: FootprintCov
column8: the PRODUCT clause `EvalIHFP noArenaFoot` (`Vsa/Sim/StrCmpCellClauses.lean`): the `Footprint` fact AND the returned value's payload covered outside the stack window `[SL.lo, SL.hi)`, both at the child's actual return. The coverage half is what `valueSurvives_of_covered` consumes, so the four `BinStrCmpCellF` cells of `BinaryFootprintCells` — a string comparison's left temporary must survive the right child — are supplyable here and not at the plain `Footprint` clause (`binStrCmpCellFP_cov`/`binStrCmpCellF_cov`, `Vsa/Sim/IHClauseGenericSupply.lean`; `PROOF_CLOSURE_PLAN.md` task 0 step (b)). Wired: the four leaves and the six one-child arms (`IHClauseGeneric.footprintCov.<case>`, whose results are payload-free ints and bools, plus the string literal's `evalStrPayloadIHF`); the remaining five EvalE steps are `footprintCov` generic hooks. UNINHABITED as a whole, exactly as `Footprint` (`hAssign`/`hFn`/`hCall` write the arena)

column8: the PRODUCT clause `EvalIHFPO stdShared noArenaFoot` (`Vsa/Sim/StrCmpCellClauses.lean`): the `Footprint` fact AND the returned value's payload covered outside the stack window AND the result slot OWNED at `stdShared`, all at the child's actual return.  This is the LEFT-operand premise `FootprintPayloadOwnedClause` of the four string-comparison cells; the RIGHT-operand premise `FootprintOwnedClause` is this clause with the coverage conjunct dropped (`EvalIHFPO.forgetCov`), so ONE recursion supplies both -- a second recursion at `EvalIHFO` could not close its own `hBinary`, which needs the coverage it drops.  The three conjuncts cannot be assembled from the landed `FootprintCov` and `OwnedPayload` clauses: two `EvalIHWithM` recursions each quantify their own reached configuration.  Guarded by `noAllocExpr` exactly as `FootprintNA`.  Wired: the four leaves, the six one-child arms (`IHClauseGenericProduct.<case>`, `Vsa/Sim/IHClauseGenericProduct.lean`; payload-free results take ownership and coverage off the exit's own `ValueRepr` through `EvalIHWithM.monoD`, the string literal through `evalStrProductIHF`), and the three allocating cases (vacuous under the guard).  Open: `hVar` (needs `VarPinnedSim` + `Rows.VarLeafResid` + the store's ownership) and `hBinary` (supplied by `IHClauseGenericProduct.hBinary` from `DivOverflowCellF`, the two `BinEqCell`s and `SharedTopSlackAll stdShared`) -- `PROOF_CLOSURE_PLAN.md` task 0 step (b)
